name: Leftovers
effect: Restores 1/16 of max HP at the end of every turn.
activation_rule: Every turn while it is battling. Never heals a fainted Pokémon.

name: Sitrus Berry
effect: Restores 1/4 of max HP when its HP falls to half or less.
activation_rule: Once per battle; ready again next battle. Never used up from your bag.

name: Focus Sash
effect: At full HP, survives a hit that would knock it out, with 1 HP left.
activation_rule: Once per battle; ready again next battle. A multi-hit move's later hits can still knock it out.

name: Quick Claw
effect: 20% chance each turn to move first among moves of the same priority.

name: Bright Powder
effect: Moves aimed at the holder have 0.9× accuracy.
activation_rule: Always active. Moves that never miss are not affected.

name: Focus Band
effect: 10% chance to survive a hit that would knock it out, with 1 HP left.
activation_rule: Rolled on every hit that would knock it out.

name: Lucky Egg
activation_rule: Battle EXP only. No effect in combat, on Power, or on any other reward.

name: Eviolite
effect: Defense and Sp. Def are 1.5× if the holder can still evolve.
activation_rule: Always active. No effect on a Pokémon that can't evolve.

name: Shell Bell
effect: Restores 1/8 of the damage its attacks deal.
activation_rule: After each attack that deals damage.

name: Black Sludge
effect: Poison types restore 1/16 of max HP each turn; any other holder loses 1/8.
activation_rule: Every turn while it is battling.

name: Light Ball
effect: Pikachu's Attack and Sp. Atk are doubled.

name: Thick Club
effect: Cubone's and Marowak's Attack is doubled.
